title: Mix Data or Merge Models? Balancing the Helpfulness, Honesty, and Harmlessness of Large Language Model via Model Merging
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning LLMs across three critical dimensions: Helpfulness, Honesty, and Harmlessness (3H). Harmlessness is explicitly defined as preventing toxic or unethical outputs. The study benchmarks and evaluates models based on their adherence to ethical constraints and responsible AI principles using safety-oriented datasets and evaluators.
